name: United Kingdom
official_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
summary: Island nation in Western Europe with a temperate maritime climate. Pioneered power grid decarbonization through rapid North Sea offshore wind deployment and the near-total phaseout of domestic coal-fired thermal electricity generation.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 1.76x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); localized nitrogen dioxide and particulate hotspots persist in London.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; second warmest calendar year on record in Met Office series.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear least-squares warming trend over 1994-2023 trailing three decades.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.8% share of global emissions; down 53% relative to 1990 baseline levels.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Below the global average of 4.7 tonnes per capita; reflects aggressive power sector clean transition.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Total woodland coverage ~3,200 km²; national target of 16.5% tree cover by 2050.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Offshore wind generated 17.3%, onshore wind 12.1%, biomass 5.2%, and solar 4.9% of national power.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 280 people/km²; urban population fraction is 84.4%.
